item.title: Second armed robbery hits Bloomington in a week
item.description: The Bloomington Police Department is investigating a second armed robbery that occurred at the Dollar Tree on North Main Street, with the suspect described as a Black man between 20 and 30 years old and the same clothing in both incidents.

item.title: Golf Learning Center in full swing, now open to public
item.description: The Golf Learning Center in Peoria, Illinois has been revamped to include 21 electronically tracked golf bays, golf simulators, and a restaurant, providing a family-friendly activity center for people to enjoy the game of golf.

item.title: More than 750 people expected for Pathway Ministries first 'Walk a Mile in My Shoes' event
item.description: Pathway Ministries is hosting its first ever "Walk a Mile in My Shoes" event, which is expected to draw over 750 participants and raise nearly $88,000 to support people experiencing homelessness in the Peoria area.

item.title: Trump calls Supreme Court justices who ruled against tariffs 'disloyal'

item.title: Illinois Congressmen react to Supreme Court striking down tariffs
item.description: The Supreme Court of the United States ruled 6-3 that President Donald Trump does not have the authority to impose tariffs, citing the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, and local lawmakers have split decisions on the ruling.

item.title: Prison sentences for two in deadly Facebook Marketplace robbery
item.description: Two men, Johnathan Williams and Tanarius Kingcade, were sentenced to 8 and 21 years in prison respectively for armed robbery in connection with a deadly Facebook Marketplace transaction in Peoria, Illinois.

item.title: Bradley University fraternity completes annual basketball run to support OSF
item.description: The Bradley University Sigma Nu chapter completed their annual 45-mile "Basketball Run" from Normal to Peoria, raising over $20,000 for the Almost Home Kids program.

item.title: Early voting turnout remains low across Central Illinois ahead of March 17 primary
item.description: Early voting is underway in Central Illinois ahead of the March 17 primary election, with turnout remaining modest so far in Peoria, Tazewell and McLean Counties.

item.title: Gov. Pritzker seeks $8.6 billion tariff refund after court ruling
item.description: Gov. JB Pritzker has sent a letter and invoice to President Donald Trump, demanding a refund of $8.6 billion in tariffs imposed on Mexican, Canadian and Chinese imports, after the Supreme Court ruled against the tariffs.

item.title: Illinois State Police Trooper involved in head-on crash
item.description: An Illinois State Trooper and another driver were injured in a head-on collision in Stark County on Friday, and both were taken to a local hospital for treatment.
